source: Synthetic, harmless fixtures authored for Pixwarden conformance tests.

vectors.description: Three opaque bytes that match no enabled format profile.
PNG signature without the required IHDR, data and end chunks.
Minimal 1x1 RGBA PNG with valid chunk CRCs; no decompression is implied.
Minimal PNG with a recomputed IHDR CRC but an invalid color type value.
A minimal synthetic PNG has one altered IDAT CRC byte while its chunk lengths and container boundaries remain intact.
Synthetic indexed-color PNG with valid chunk CRCs but no required PLTE chunk.
Synthetic PNG separates two IDAT chunks with a valid ancillary tEXt chunk; all CRCs are correct.
PNG contains an unknown uppercase critical chunk with a correct CRC.
PNG chunk type begins with a non-letter byte while its chunk CRC is correct.
PNG ancillary chunk uses a lowercase third type letter, setting the reserved chunk-type bit.
Minimal one-frame GIF with bounded data sub-blocks.
A bounded one-frame GIF has an LZW minimum code size below the legal 2–8 range.
A bounded one-frame GIF sets a reserved image descriptor bit that the specification requires to be zero.
A one-frame GIF has a Graphic Control Extension with a set reserved bit.
A GIF Plain Text Extension uses an 11-byte header instead of the required 12 bytes.
A GIF Application Extension uses a 10-byte header instead of the required 11 bytes.
A GIF Application Extension has a non-printable byte in its eight-byte application identifier.
A synthetic GIF descriptor advertises a local color table that extends beyond the input boundary.
Minimal marker-valid JPEG frame and scan; pixel decoding is not asserted.
Minimal JPEG has a SOF segment length smaller than its required two-byte length field.
Marker-bounded JPEG has a frame header and EOI but no start-of-scan segment.
Minimal marker-valid JPEG has one inert byte after EOI.
Minimal RIFF/WebP container with a non-empty VP8 chunk; codec decoding is not asserted.
Synthetic 1x1 extended WebP container with a bounded VP8X canvas header and non-empty VP8 chunk; codec decoding is not asserted.
Synthetic WebP RIFF chunk with an odd payload length and a non-zero padding byte.
Synthetic extended WebP container sets a reserved VP8X flag bit.
Synthetic PNG carrying a bounded TIFF EXIF directory with a GPS pointer tag; no private value is present.
Synthetic PNG with an eight-byte malformed EXIF/TIFF payload and no active or private content.
PNG ancillary text chunk contains a harmless ZIP local-header signature indicator; it is not an executable payload.
Synthetic GIF comment extension contains a harmless format-signature indicator.
Synthetic JPEG APP0 segment contains a harmless format-signature indicator.
Synthetic WebP XMP chunk contains a harmless format-signature indicator.
Minimal static SVG using one allowed shape and no references or active content.
SVG comment and CDATA text contain DTD-like words but no actual declaration.
Synthetic SVG with script and event-handler content; instructions are inert and never executed.
SVG fill and stroke values use CSS escapes and comments to form URL-like functions.
Two-pixel synthetic PNG scanned under a one-pixel width policy.
Two-frame synthetic GIF scanned under a one-frame policy.
A one-frame GIF whose image rectangle extends beyond a zero-width logical screen.
A truncated GIF header declares a 50000-pixel width beyond the default resource policy.
A GIF with a valid logical screen and trailer but no image descriptor.
A valid one-frame GIF is followed by one byte after its trailer.
A GIF image stream contains an unknown block introducer before the image descriptor.
A GIF image descriptor positions its frame outside the one-pixel logical screen.
A GIF image descriptor declares zero frame width while the logical screen is nonzero.
PNG IEND chunk declares one payload byte when its chunk has none.
PNG IDAT chunk type contains a non-letter byte and its existing CRC no longer matches.
PNG IHDR declares an over-policy width while its CRC is stale.
A WebP RIFF header declares a container length larger than the available input.
A WebP image chunk declares payload bytes beyond the RIFF boundary.
A bounded WebP container has an unknown chunk but no supported image payload.
A valid minimal PNG is followed by one byte after IEND.
A valid minimal WebP has one byte after its declared RIFF container.
A minimal PNG carries a harmless synthetic tEXt chunk that the limited privacy transform must remove.
A one-pixel static RGBA8 PNG with harmless iTXt metadata and known pixel bytes for bounded decode/reconstruction.
A 1x5 RGBA8 PNG uses each of the five PNG filter types in sequence; reconstructed pixel bytes are known.
A valid one-pixel RGBA8 PNG has a trailing byte after the end of the IDAT zlib stream; the raster transform must reject it.
A one-pixel RGBA8 PNG inflates to more scanline bytes than its dimensions permit; the raster transform must reject it.
Synthetic uncompressed PNG text metadata with instruction-override language; advisory AI text rules should flag it without exposing its contents.
Benign uncompressed PNG text metadata with imperative vocabulary but no override pattern; should not be flagged.
Synthetic zTXt metadata compresses a narrow instruction-override phrase; bounded decompression should emit a redacted advisory signal.
Synthetic compressed iTXt metadata contains an instruction-override phrase; bounded decompression should emit a redacted advisory signal.
Synthetic compressed iTXt metadata contains benign imperative vocabulary without an override phrase; bounded decompression should not flag it.
Highly repetitive compressed PNG text is smaller than the metadata input budget but expands beyond the bounded decompression output; the analyzer must return partial without a match claim.
One-pixel static RGBA8 PNG requests bounded descriptive LSB and transparent-pixel statistics; report remains inconclusive and policy review is required.
Synthetic JPEG COM metadata contains a narrow instruction-override phrase; bounded advisory inspection should flag it with redacted evidence.
Synthetic JPEG COM metadata contains benign imperative text without an override phrase; it should not be flagged.
Synthetic JPEG COM metadata exceeds the configured metadata inspection budget; both runtimes report the limit and leave AI metadata inspection incomplete.
Synthetic GIF comment extension exceeds the configured metadata budget; PHP and JS both emit META-006.
Synthetic PNG text metadata exceeds the byte budget; META-006 is emitted and AI metadata matching remains incomplete.
Synthetic WebP XMP metadata exceeds the byte budget while the independent bounded binary indicator remains visible.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF ASCII UserComment contains a narrow instruction-override phrase; inspection must redact the value.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF ASCII UserComment contains benign description text and should not trigger the narrow rule.
Synthetic EXIF UserComment uses an unsupported JIS encoding marker; the opt-in rule must report incomplete rather than pass its control.
Synthetic EXIF UserComment offset escapes its APP1 segment; the advisory parser must report incomplete and never read out of bounds.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF UserComment uses a big-endian TIFF IFD chain and contains a narrow override phrase; the bounded rule must find it.
Synthetic PNG eXIf chunk contains an ASCII EXIF UserComment override phrase; the optional rule must flag it with redacted evidence.
Synthetic PNG eXIf chunk contains benign ASCII EXIF UserComment text and should not trigger the narrow rule.
Synthetic WebP EXIF chunk contains an ASCII UserComment override phrase; the optional rule must emit a redacted AI-002 finding.
Synthetic WebP EXIF chunk contains benign ASCII UserComment text and should not trigger the narrow rule.
PNG EXIF UserComment exceeds the configured metadata budget; AI inspection must remain partial and cannot pass.
WebP EXIF UserComment exceeds the configured metadata budget; AI inspection must remain partial and policy must reject.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 little-endian in a little-endian TIFF directory; bounded inspection must redact an override signal.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 big-endian in a big-endian TIFF directory; bounded inspection must redact an override signal.
Synthetic JPEG EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 little-endian in a little-endian TIFF directory; bounded inspection must allow benign descriptive text.
Synthetic PNG EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 little-endian with a narrow override phrase; inspection must flag it and redact text.
Synthetic PNG EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 big-endian with a narrow override phrase; inspection must flag it and redact text.
Synthetic PNG EXIF UserComment uses an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate and must remain incomplete.
Synthetic WEBP EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 little-endian with a narrow override phrase; inspection must flag it and redact text.
Synthetic WEBP EXIF UserComment uses UTF-16 big-endian with a narrow override phrase; inspection must flag it and redact text.
Synthetic WEBP EXIF UserComment uses an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate and must remain incomplete.
A one-byte WebP EXIF chunk followed by bytes resembling the Exif prefix must keep metadata evidence inside the chunk.
